FDE.Title: Encounter Forge
FDE.LoadPartyHint: Reload the party from the dnd5e Primary Party (or player-owned characters)
FDE.PartyEmpty: No characters yet. Add one, or drag actors here.
FDE.PartyDropHint: Drag characters or NPCs here. NPCs join as allies and add to the budget.
FDE.HomebrewHint: Not in the 2024 DMG: anything above the High budget. Shown here as up to 150% of High.
FDE.MaxCRHint: The 2024 DMG warns that creatures with a CR above the party's level can be very dangerous.
FDE.GeneratorHint: Uses the bestiary filters on the right (except search) as the monster pool.
FDE.EncounterEmpty: Add creatures from the bestiary, drag NPCs here, or press Generate.
FDE.ActionEconomyHint: Optional heuristic, not in the 2024 rules: lone non-legendary monsters count for less XP (×0.75 / ×0.9), large hordes for more (×1.1 / ×1.25).
FDE.Name: Name
FDE.SourcesHint: Choose which Actor compendiums to search. Leaving all of them ticked also includes packs installed later.
FDE.IncludeWorld: Include NPCs from the world's Actors directory
FDE.FiltersHint: Click + to add (Shift-click adds 5). Drag a row to the party to add it as an ally.

Warn.NoParty: Add the party to see the budget.
Warn.NoPCs: Only allies on the party side: no one earns XP.
Warn.OverHigh: Over the High budget. The 2024 DMG doesn't go past High; expect characters to drop and possibly die.
Warn.Extreme: Far beyond High (over 150%). A total party kill is a real possibility.
Warn.CRAbove: {name} (CR {cr}) is above the party's level ({level}). It can deal enough damage in one turn to down a character.
Warn.Level1: Level 1 characters are fragile: creatures above CR 1 can kill one in a single hit.
Warn.SoloNoLegendary: A single creature with no legendary actions loses the action-economy race. It will probably be easier than its XP suggests.
Warn.Horde: {count} creatures is more than two per party member. That's a lot of attacks per round and slow to run.
Warn.WeakFodder: Most of these creatures are very low CR for this party. They'll rarely hit, so the fight may be easier than its XP total.

Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can use the Encounter Forge.
Notify.NoScene: There's no active scene to place tokens on.
Notify.NotNPC: Only NPC actors can be enemies.
Notify.EmptyPool: No monsters match the filters and CR cap.
Notify.GenFailed: Couldn't build an encounter from this monster pool.
Notify.Closest: Couldn't hit the target exactly with these filters. This is the closest match.

allyWeight.Name: Ally weight
allyWeight.Hint: How much an allied NPC adds to the party budget. At 1, a CR X ally counts as one level-X character (fractional CRs count as part of a level-1 character). Lower it for allies that fight poorly.

actionEconomy.Name: Action-economy adjustment
actionEconomy.Hint: Optional heuristic on top of the 2024 rules: rate lone non-legendary monsters lower and big hordes higher.

placeHidden.Name: Place tokens hidden
placeHidden.Hint: Tokens placed by the builder start hidden from players.

addToCombat.Name: Add placed tokens to combat
addToCombat.Hint: Add placed tokens to this scene's unstarted combat encounter, creating one if needed.

importFolder.Name: Import folder
importFolder.Hint: Actors folder for monsters imported from compendiums.
